exposure: timing of cesarean section (emergency vs. planned)
type of surgery (Cesarean hysterectomy vs. modified one-step conservative uterine surgery (MOSCUS))
cohort: 497 pregnant women with PASDs beyond 28 weeks of gestation
finding: Neonatal outcomes were significantly poorer in the emergency cesarean section group compared to the planned cesarean section group, while there was no significant difference in outcomes between Cesarean hysterectomy and MOSCUS.
